title: OAuthAccountWriteRequest
description: Legacy manual import shape. Normal Control Panel clients must create connected accounts through OAuth callback only; manual refresh token entry is disabled.

provider_type.description: Must match the referenced OAuth provider. Connected Drive/YouTube accounts currently require google.

scopes.description: Drive destinations require a Google Drive scope. YouTube Live API outputs require a YouTube scope.

refresh_token.description: Manual refresh token input is disabled for normal clients. OAuth callback stores the token encrypted at rest and it is never returned by API, UI, logs, audit metadata, or diagnostics.
